dogecoin.text: We'll need mass adoption and a gigantic amount of transactions using #dogecoin as a currency for its price to eventually stabilize around the 1 dollar mark. The #memecoin can become a #utilitycoin. (2/2)

My take on the future of #dogecoin: tomorrow it could see its biggest pump and the final event in the #dogecoin surge. If @elonmusk mentions Doge at #SaturdayNightLive, we could see the token's price raise to 1 dollar or more. Then, its price will go back down. (1/2)
